description: Frozen shared vectors for the node-traffic-v1 codec.
usage: Python tests/test_node_traffic_contract.py and the later Go internal/traffic golden tests read this file. Expected canonical text and digests are frozen; tests must never regenerate them from a codec. canonical_vectors[].snapshot is a complete snapshot including digest; payload_canonical and snapshot_canonical are the exact UTF-8 text. equivalence_vectors[].request_raw is a complete request body whose single snapshot must canonicalize to the named vector. request_vectors[] pairs ordered canonical-vector names with literal request_canonical bytes for encode_request. bounds.named_identities and bounds.aggregate_slots define the combined named-identity ceiling; named_identity_boundaries give deterministic generated-name recipes, expected named counts, byte sizes and results. request_rejections use raw text, or raw_hex when the bytes are not valid UTF-8. receipt_vectors/receipt_rejections pair a request_raw with a response_raw. Raw bodies or canonical envelopes over their bounds use request_too_large; response overflow uses request_too_large too.
